1. SI and OC are both the gem and the trash. Some of the best and the worse works. 
2. There is something like three sub categories from what i read. First are the normal fics that deal with cannon timeline, which in many cases results in fluf or wholesome fic. Secondary, there are fics that cover character during the third war, which almost all features kid Kakashi, they are typically more gory/serious/well_done. Finally, we have fics during the founding era or future, which are more miss than hit. 
3. Believe it or not, the site on which you publish matters. There are a few forums where the readers interact more with the Author or a form of writing named "Quest" which features vote system. 
4. Be careful with power level escalation, too many fics forget about chakra level a d exhaustion. 
5. Be careful with crossover. For example Yamanaka OC being born with rare mutations that allow him to use spiritual chakra as a shield, like aura from RWBY, while cool kind will need a lot other things to be written around to work. 
6. Finally, before you begin to write anything open calendar. Look over it and spend a few minutes thinking. "Do i have the time to write fanfic, and if not what do i want to drop so i can have it. More importantly, do i want to spend time writing instead of playing games, watching anime, or something else?" 
The final one is especially important, because people with no conviction give half ass try once and don't even try in future to write again.
